title: Wave mapping & ops cadence for Private/VPC quarterly roadmap
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Objective: produce a defensible quarterly wave map for Private/VPC/on-prem activations that ties each wave to a clear set of OKR outcomes, operational readiness gates, and per-wave cost/runway estimates. This ticket centralizes the cross-functional decisions that will: (1) define cohort definitions and success metrics per wave, (2) enumerate the gating checklist for each customer (compatibility matrix, KMS/HSM proof, network egress testing), (3) align engineering delivery slices to runbook milestones and SRE readiness, and (4) produce the executive-facing OG/OKR mapping that product, sales, and support will use to commit to customer timelines.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A published Wave Map spreadsheet (by cohort) with start/end windows and estimated infra cost per week.
2) Ops readiness checklist completed for Wave 1 and Wave 2 with owners assigned.
3) Risk register and mitigation plan reviewed in cross-functional sync.
4) OKR mapping doc linking waves to two platform OKRs (uptime/SLO adherence and time-to-first-response for on-prem incidents).
5) Stakeholder sign-off from Product, SRE, Sales AE, and Solutions Engineering.
milestones: Feb 01: Draft cohort segmentation and cost model published
Feb 18: Ops readiness checklist prototype + compatibility matrix v0.1
Mar 03: Cross-functional review and risk-adjusted scheduling
Mar 18: Final wave map + OKR mapping published
Mar 31: Executive review and launch authorization
success_metrics: Wave 1 activation completed with mean time-to-first-successful-request < 6 hours
Zero critical regressions in core serving runtime during Wave 1 (0 severity-1 incidents)
<=10% variance between estimated and actual infra cost in Wave 1
Customer satisfaction (NPS follow-up) >= +30 for Wave 1 onboarded customers
risks: Compatibility gaps with customer-managed KMS/HSM delaying onboarding
Undetected network egress/firewall patterns causing degraded latency in private regions
Underestimated ops staffing needs during simultaneous waves
Model variant/quantization mismatches requiring runtime adjustments mid-wave
rollout_plan: We will run a three-wave rollout. Wave 0 (internal pilot): 2 customers + internal staging to validate preflight tests and upgrade playbook. Wave 1 (small cohort): 6 low-risk customers (contracted with limited SLAs) to validate ops runbook and cost model. Wave 2 (broader cohort): 15 customers segmented by region and compliance needs. Each wave has gated entry: preflight green (compatibility tests), security approval (KMS/SAML), and capacity reservation confirmation. If any gate fails, the wave is held and remediation tasks are scheduled with target SLAs. The plan includes a dark-launch path to mirror telemetry for Wave 1 before full traffic cutover.
